description: Export a load as a machine-readable LOADING WORK ORDER: a numbered stuffing sequence (which SKU, where, in what order and orientation), the securing/bracing action list, a securing shopping list per container (`securingBom`: straps, airbags, timber, bars, with quantities, specs and the work-order steps each goes to; recommendations to verify with the carrier), the key declarable figures (VGM, axle load, centre of gravity), and an optional per-retailer inbound-packaging check (Amazon FBA / Walmart). Feed it to a WES/TMS, a robotic palletiser, or a printable worker sheet. A real API key packs it with the production PackingSolver optimizer (the same plan plan_load returns for the same cargo); the public demo key uses the offline preview packer; `engine` in the result says which one ran. This is decision support to MEET published retailer/carrier specs — verify in your own portal; it is not a retailer certification.

equipmentCode.description: Equipment code, e.g. 40HC (see list_equipment). Omit to auto right-size.

id.description: Your reference for this cargo line

thisSideUp.description: Must stay upright — restricts the packer to upright orientations

unNumber.description: UN number (e.g. "UN1263") — derives the IMDG class/PG/segregation/stowage/EmS from the DGL.

mode.description: Transport mode for auto right-size (ignored when equipmentCode is given).

retailers.description: Retailer inbound-packaging profiles to check the load against.

name: export_plan
